## Identity

Frantisek Kalasek / TopBot PwnZ is a Czech freelance technology brand focused on practical digital systems, web applications, PWA solutions, automation, API integrations, cloud and self-hosted systems, and technology consulting. The work emphasizes clear scope, practical delivery, maintainable operation, and a direct path from the first idea to a usable technical output.
